name: Thumbnail
description: Draws each point marker as the feature's own image, taken from a URL on the feature. Field photos, sample close-ups and site pictures become recognisable on the map instead of identical dots. It decorates its host instead of drawing a sublayer, so it never appears in the layer's Composite Layers list.

components.name: Enabled
components.description: Draws this layer's point markers as the image found at 'Image Property' on each feature. Features without that property keep the layer's normal marker.

components.name: Image Property
components.description: The dot.notated path to the feature property holding the image URL. Ex. thumbnail, or images.0.url.

components.name: Size
components.description: Width and height of the thumbnail marker in pixels.

components.name: Shape
components.description: Whether the thumbnail is clipped to a circle or left square.

components.name: Border Color
components.description: Color of the ring drawn around the thumbnail.

components.name: Border Width
components.description: Thickness in pixels of the ring drawn around the thumbnail. 0 for no ring.
